constraints_found.source_line: cyrus: "Next on my list is burgers. There's a whole cluster of grill stalls by the fountain."

constraints_found.constraint: Budget: cheapest tier ($). One tier over ($$) costs a star; two over ($$$) is a deal-breaker
constraints_found.source_line: maya: "cheapest-stall small. a little over and i'll sulk the whole bus ride home. fancy prices and i'm turning around at the gate"

cyrus: "...at least one grill here brushes satay sauce on everything. Satay and I have history, so that stall is crossed out." confirmed by liam: "anything peanut-y stays on the far side of the fountain"

constraints_found.constraint: Vegetarian (strict diet, deal-breaker): needs a meatless burger listed on the menu, not a workaround
constraints_found.source_line: liam: "patrol rules: mina gets a burger with zero meat in it, picked off the board like the rest of us" (backstory: "mina had a plate of fries because nothing on that menu worked for her")

constraints_found.constraint: Dairy intolerance (costs one star, not a deal-breaker)
constraints_found.source_line: roxy: "...no sequel. hold the cheese, no creamy sauce, no shake. my stomach makes the rules"

venue_evaluation.night_market_hollow_oak: Out: peanuts are the house signature (peanut butter, satay sauce, peanut slaw). Cyrus's allergy.
venue_evaluation.campus_bun_stop: Safe ($, never had a peanut, vegan black bean patty on the board) but dairy everywhere (butter-toasted brioche, cheese on classics, garlic butter fries). Roxy loses a star: 2 stars.
venue_evaluation.night_market_amber_lamp: $, peanut-free kitchen, black bean burger and grilled mushroom stack are meatless menu items, oil not butter and no cheese at all. Meets everything: 3 stars.
venue_evaluation.night_market_velvet_tent: Out: board is meat top to bottom, beef-dripping fries and bacon beans; nothing for Mina.
venue_evaluation.night_market_midnight_orchard: $$ (one tier over): peanut-free, meatless patties, no dairy. 2 stars.
venue_evaluation.night_market_crooked_pine: Out: $$$ is two tiers over Maya's budget.

notes: Peanut clue is indirect ('Satay and I have history') but Liam's 'anything peanut-y' line makes it fair.
Mina's vegetarian constraint is never stated by her; it comes from Liam's 'zero meat' and the fries backstory. Fair and nicely done.
Roxy's dairy clue leans on the 'milkshake incident' callback, but 'hold the cheese, no creamy sauce, no shake. my stomach makes the rules' is clear enough on its own.

Bun Stop is a good decoy: cheap, peanut-free and has a vegan patty, so only the dairy clue separates it from Amber Lamp. Its id prefix 'campus_' and its location at the north gate (not the fountain cluster) are hints a careful player might notice, but I did not rely on them.
Midnight Orchard and Crooked Pine are cleanly ruled out by price tier on the card. Nothing felt unfair or contradictory.
